# Coordinated re-gate checkpoints: brainstorming #42 preserve receipts All calls below are narrated, not executed. No tool was run, and no reference content is reconstructed. Reads are skill resources loaded with `read` at their `skills/` paths. Where the bundled text sets no literal, the stop line is built from the closest existing stop and marked †. ## Command legend The angle-bracket names stand in for the following: - `

` is a primary checkout: `/work/widget`, `/work/helper`, or `/work/codec`. - `` is that primary's worktree: `

/.worktrees/spec-export`. | Id | Command | |---|---| | C1 | `gh pr view 42 -R acme/widget --json number,url,state,isDraft,title,body,headRefName,headRefOid,headRepository,isCrossRepository,baseRefName` | | C2 | `git -C /work/widget fetch origin main spec-export`, then `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main` (prints `5555…`) | | C3 | `git -C /work/widget diff --name-status 5555…...1111…` (prints `A doc/specs/export.md`) | | C4 | `git -C /work/widget show 1111…:doc/specs/export.md` | | C5 | `git -C

fetch origin` | | C6 | `git -C

The shape passes. - Run C4. The exact `**Engine:** deferred` marker appears before the first `##`. - The original head carries **2** `### Leg:` blocks: `acme/widget` and `acme/helper`. - SYNC is forced to merge. Binding, gather, and the thread query are skipped. The thread query is never attempted. 2. **Provision home** through pr-head. - Run C5 on `/work/widget`. Ordered stops all pass. - No local branch exists, so run C7 and verify HEAD is `1111…`. - Run `update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 1111…`. - Run C9. The merge is clean, recorded as `merge: `. 3. **Home report.** ``` Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export Branch: spec-export Base: spec-export @ 1111111 PR: acme/widget#42 Pre-rework head: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 Base SHA: 5555555 create: override skipped (contains -b) ``` The recorded `create:` contains `-b`, so the built-in checkout runs instead. The independent `-B` delta takes the same built-in path and prints the same literal skip line. 4. **Settle membership.** - Read C10. It declares two siblings: helper, then codec. - Match the carried leg identifiers before any probe. Only `acme/helper` matches, so codec is never probed. 5. **Preflight all companions** before any tree is created: - C11 on `/work/helper` returns `acme/helper`, and the canonical path is not home. - C12 finds no local branch or path collision. - C5, then C6 returns exit 0 with `2222…`. - Companions use their own settings and overrides by file, never the session `gauntlet_setting`. 6. **Provision the companion.** - Run C7 on `/work/helper`. - Run the C8 read-backs: the worktree is listed and the branch prints exactly `spec-export`. - Run C9. The merge is clean. - The same `create: override skipped (contains -b)` line is printed. 7. **Gate inventory**, home first: ``` Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export Worktree ready at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export ``` 8. **Gate.** - Pin the audit with `git -C log -1 --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- doc/specs/export.md`, which returns `6666…`. Its body carries all three labels. - Run the summarizer with a fresh temp path. The last-content `Read` is pasted verbatim: "Retried exports retain receipts." - Remove the temp file. - Render the gate lines: ``` Scope cuts: none Council: 0 applied, 0 deferred, 0 rejected ``` - Options 1/2/3/4/5 are rendered, with 3 enabled by the pinned audit. - Option 6 is withheld: `Withheld: draft PR - #42 already exists`. --- ## B. Three legs; codec's remote branch deleted 1. C5 on `/work/codec` succeeds, but the stale `origin/spec-export` still resolves to `3333…`. The stale ref is not trusted. 2. **Absence case.** C6 returns exit 2 with no output. Stop before any companion add, local-ref update, or merge: ``` leg acme/codec: origin has no branch spec-export (ls-remote exit 2; stale origin/spec-export 3333333 ignored); push spec-export from the originating machine and rerun brainstorming #42 † Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export ``` 3. **Transport-failure case (independent).** C6 returns exit 128. This is not proof of absence: ``` leg acme/codec: could not query origin for spec-export (ls-remote exit 128: fatal: unable to access origin); retry when origin is reachable † ``` The same inventory follows. 4. **Recovery on the originating machine.** - Run `git -C /work/codec log -1 --format=%H refs/heads/spec-export -- doc/specs/export.md`. It returns `7777…`. - Run `git -C /work/codec push -u origin spec-export`. - Rerun `brainstorming #42`. - The primary is never checked out, and the run never stops incomplete. 5. **Commit exists nowhere (independent).** The log returns nothing. Stop, regenerate nothing: ``` leg acme/codec: no spec-export ref carries doc/specs/export.md; the coordinated spec is incomplete - restore the leg branch by hand and rerun † ``` --- ## C. Three legs; no codec declaration at BASE_SHA 1. C10 at `5555…` declares only helper. The worktree copy's codec declaration is ignored because the base-SHA read is authoritative. 2. Stop with no companion write: ``` leg acme/codec in doc/specs/export.md matches no - sibling: declaration in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md at 5555555; declare it on main or amend the spec † ``` 3. **Independent validation failures** use legs.md's validation stop, which names the declaration line: | Case | Stop | |---|---| | Missing PATH | `- sibling: https://github.com/acme/helper.git: PATH /work/helper missing` | | Wrong origin | `- sibling: https://github.com/acme/helper.git: origin acme/other is not acme/helper` | | PATH equals home | `- sibling: https://github.com/acme/helper.git: PATH equals home /work/widget` | 4. If the last selected checkout (codec) is missing, validation completes for every member before any tree exists. No companion is created or synced, not even helper. --- ## D. Contract drift; malformed block 1. **Drift stops.** Recorded contracts are authoritative, so there is no silent choice and no provisioning. ``` leg acme/helper: recorded home: .worktrees/ (/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export) differs from resolved home: trees/ (/work/helper/trees/spec-export); amend the recorded contract or restore the setting, then rerun † ``` ``` leg acme/helper: recorded create: git worktree add -b differs from resolved create: workspace add ; amend the recorded contract or restore the setting, then rerun † ``` 2. **Contract repair** runs through the amendment surface. - Rewrite the home `### Leg: acme/helper` block, then commit home. - In the same amendment, rewrite and commit `/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export/doc/specs/export.md` via `git -C`. - The amendment is not complete until both carried copies agree. 3. **Malformed third block (independent).** Home is preserved: ``` ## Legs block 3 lacks repo|branch|contract:; repair the spec and rerun brainstorming #42 † ``` --- ## E. Partial provision and reruns 1. **First run.** - Home base merge `8888…` succeeds. - Helper reports ready. - The codec preflight finds `worktree /work/host/spec-export` and stops. Nothing is removed: ``` branch spec-export is checked out at /work/host/spec-export; finish or remove that worktree first. Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export ``` 2. **Rerun: recover home.** - Run `git -C /work/widget rev-parse refs/heads/spec-export`. It returns `8888…`. - Run `git -C /work/widget log --first-parent --format='%H %P %s' 1111…..8888…`. It shows one two-parent merge whose second parent is an ancestor of `origin/main`. The tree is clean. - Reuse the worktree unchanged. Run no reset and no update-ref. Print: ``` Base sync recovered: 8888888 merge: no-op - head contains origin/main ``` 3. **Helper merge unresolved (independent).** C9 conflicts in `doc/specs/old.md`. The helper fails, and `merge --abort` restores the tree: ``` base merge unresolved for leg acme/helper (doc/specs/old.md) - merge origin/main by hand in /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export and rerun brainstorming #42 Preserved created legs: acme/widget …, acme/helper … ``` 4. **After the user merges by hand.** - The tip becomes `9999…`. The same proof passes. - The rerun prints `Base sync recovered: 9999999` without any reset. 5. **Unrelated local commit (alternative).** The helper tip `aaaa…` is an ordinary commit beyond `origin/spec-export`. Stop, never reset: ``` worktree /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export on spec-export carries commits beyond origin/spec-export (2222222) that are not base-sync merges (aaaaaaa); resolve by hand or remove the worktree. † ``` 6. **Race backstop.** - Codec's remote branch is deleted after the preflight and after helper is provisioned. - C5 succeeds, but the stale ref still resolves to `3333…`. - The repeated C6 returns exit 2. The B absence stop prints, before any codec write, with an inventory of home and helper. - Exit 128 instead prints the B transport stop. That case is not treated as absence. --- ## F. Gate actions from A 1. **Approval `1`.** - Decode the grant through Standing grants. - Edit only the home spec header to: ``` **Amend-grant:** none **Engine:** waves **PR:** acme/widget#42 ``` - Make a new commit `spec: select engine and grant for PR #42`, never `--amend`. - Verify all three fields via `git show HEAD:doc/specs/export.md`. - Companion files are untouched. - Run `phase_tracker complete brainstorm`, then `/skill:writing-plans`. 2. **Change request (independent).** Shared Design changes to "Keep receipts with pending status." - Revise and commit home in a new commit without the old audit body. - Rewrite and commit the live helper file with the shared change. - Run a fresh summarizer with a fresh temp path, then re-present the gate. - No second council runs, and no approval is inferred. - Council counts still come from the pinned `6666…` audit, and grant decoding is unchanged. 3. **Never produced on this route:** - companion `**PR:**` fields - companion pre-rework refs - MEMBER_HEADS entries - thread fetches - a handoff or resume route
